description: This file defines API endpoints related to authentication in a FastAPI application, including login, current user retrieval, and dependency handling for OAuth2 authentication.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Response model for returning JWT tokens.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: Model for login request payload, imported but not directly used.

methods.name: Optional[asyncpg.Record] _get_user_by_username(conn: asyncpg.Connection, username: str)
methods.description: Fetches a user record from the database by username.

methods.name: Token login(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), conn: asyncpg.Connection = Depends(get_connection))
methods.description: Handles user login, verifies credentials, and returns a JWT token.

methods.name: User get_current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme), conn: asyncpg.Connection = Depends(get_connection))
methods.description: Retrieves and verifies the current user based on JWT token.

methods.name: User me(user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns the current authenticated user's information.
